value.rationale: For simple spin-factor Jordan algebras of dimension at least five, nonzero rank one is the first natural nonzero Rota–Baxter stratum. The classification gives complete intrinsically defined image-type multiplicities across all odd finite fields, a smooth geometric realization, and a discriminant-reconstruction theorem. Even-dimensional cancellation in the total count shows that the refined invariant captures algebra structure invisible to raw counts. These are motivated structural and arithmetic results rather than a parameter substitution or arbitrary small table.
